notes.title: Devblog#36 The Reboot Version is now on the DefaultBranch
notes.notes:
[h1]I cleaned up the Server and accidentally forget how to set the Config File[/h1]

The Server used for Build8 was created almost 2 years ago. Normally I will just restart the server regularly without touching the config file. This time though, I delete the server and download the clean version of Build8 and it cannot start because I have to set the config file which I forget already.

So I brought the latest version on the ExperimentalBranch to the NormalBranch instead.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31592810/baacadccfc6495284cb1fd428c6d9caa298899c8.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31592810/6b0b5f15933fca875205a8bf0545117e80684a2a.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31592810/cf44ff2a03b66eaa607f50c7a52f7623c549472f.jpg[/img]

[h1]The Reboot Version[/h1]

This version doesn't inherit from Build8 at all. So there are many features that are still missing. I'm so sorry for the inconvenience.

However, there is a new feature introduced, it is "Discord Semi-Proximity VoiceChat". It works like a Proximity VoiceChat but the volume is constant(not change according to the distance). The talking radius is around 5 meters. [u][b]The system requires you to have Discord opened and logged in before you enter the game. The Push-to-Talk button is LeftAlt.[/b][/u]

[h3]Some Technical Details[/h3]
[list]
[*]It is built on Unreal Engine 5 (Build8 used Unreal Engine 4)
[*]Doesn't use Lumen yet(Lumen makes lighting more beautiful but can be a burden on lower-end machines)
[*]Doesn't use Nanite for the same reason and this feature will require a DirectX12-supported machine to run so I don't plan to use it anytime soon.
[*]Framerate is currently capped at 60 FPS until I create an options menu.
[*]I lower the resolution to 45% of the screen but add the SuperSampling as an Anti-Aliasing method. I expect a decent/good picture and smoother framerate.
[*]Require a DirectX11-supported machine to run. (Also update Graphic Driver to the latest version)
[/list]

[h1]Next?[/h1]

I will continue to accumulate new features on the ExperimentalBranch. The next version on the DefaultBranch will be called [u][b]Build9[/b][/u] despite missing many features and gameplay I promised earlier. I will bring back "The Welcome Box" very soon. ːfuelcanː

This is my work-in-progress board.ːemofdrː
[url=https://open.codecks.io/villages]https://open.codecks.io/villages[/url]


As always, thanks to my sponsor 
[url=https://zap-hosting.com/en/]ZAP-Hosting[/url]
You can visit their website for more services.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31592810/c851f521f5f28b690f52d51302ec218fcd1396f3.png[/img]

notes.title: Devblog #25 Just a Transition Update V0.2.4.6.1
notes.notes:
[h1]This is not the update everyone expects, not yet.[/h1]
As I have mentioned earlier, I switch the underlying code plugin to my own version. Everything may not change much visually but it took a lot of time to recover its functionality. Today I just make up those functionality to meet the previous version. I decide to push this update because I think it can lead to a smoother transition to V0.2.4.6a in the future.

In the meantime you can explore new menus.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31592810/d4097b9e104d026e24978804c368b5ff92eb69af.jpg[/img]

[h1]It may have a lot of bugs or even crash.[/h1]
If you have a problem, you can enter our Steam group chat from this button. There is the "Bug Report" section, it's likely I can see your message. Also, feel free to talk to our friends there. Just talk politely is enough, I'm too lazy to enforce so many rules.ːdh3_PoliceOfficerː 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31592810/7d936d9fc4ef17f4d739828052dd3017dcb1894d.jpg[/img]


See you next update. Hopefully, it's the V0.2.4.6a.ːemofdrː

notes.title: Devblog #10 [XP] Partial Update : Add Item Management Menu
notes.notes:
[h1]Multiplayer mode delayed[/h1]
I need 1-2 more weeks to make it.

[h1]Now we have new item menu, and new currency[/h1]
I create an Item Management Menu. You can access this menu from the main menu (press "The International Market").

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31592810/445b241b02cb84b0348f022543e331e268c498cc.jpg[/img]

I introduce you a new currency called [b][u]"Labour Union Credit"[/u][/b], [b]LUC[/b] for short.

This currency can obtained by playing in [b]Multiplayer Mode in Experimental Branch only[/b]. Its propose is to pay for everyone who help me test new things. You can spend this credit in both Normal Server and XP Server.

LUC is different from Katta in term of supplies. LUC is relatively limited but can buy item directly from NPC without limit. Katta has some degree of inflation and use for buying limit things, it will drive economy more than using barter-system.

Every major updates will contain quests that pay you credits from 1000-10000 LUC. Quests will reset or change so make sure you complete them before new update is come.

[h1]What you can do from the item menu?[/h1]
- You can recieve "The Welcome Box" every week.
- You can request packing your inventory.(You don't have to use packing map anymore)
- You can open item that considered a lootbox.
- You can buy Labour Union Credit Kard with your credit.
- You can redeem a card into your credit.
[b][u]- Your can buy "Fast-Sale Seal" and apply to an item. When you sell sealed items it guarantee that buyers alway can buy from you more than one time.[/u][/b] It will cost you 25 LUC per seal.

When you first join this system you will get 1,247 LUC.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31592810/eab7b9d9280477551ab994fd00472e20df14a9bd.jpg[/img]

Make sure you read warning before proceed action.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31592810/6ce34968730dbe6c56a41d091bb9d21d593746c6.jpg[/img]

You can also access this menu in the game too.
[b]If you cannot see the yellow button you may need to verify the game and wait until it finish downloading[/b]


That is for now. See you next update.:emofdr:

------------------------------

notes.title: Devblog #9 [XP] Short News : Next update with multiplayer mode coming in 14 days.
notes.notes:
[h1]Delayed, as alway[/h1]
Next update was planned to finish this week but it's delayed. I wish to deliver it with in next 14 days or sooner.

[h1]What will include in the next update[/h1]
I've just finish networking part of the new vehicle system so it's time to test it in multiplayer mode. Rather than just testing, I will introduce a quest system for use in Experimental Branch only. These quests will grant you new credit for later use in both Default Server and XP Server.

New things to add
- Test Driving Job (again but with my new system)
- Quest System (XP Branch only)
- Start dropping "The Welcome Box"
- New currency "Labour Union Credit (LUC)"
- Buyable/Applyable "Fast-Sale Seal" (using LUC)
- Unlock some acheivements

[h1]It's look like it's not going anywhere[/h1]
No. Experimental Branch is a chance to develop this game more continuously. Previous 2 versions(V0.1.0&V0.2.0 ) is made with not so well-written systems, they all have to be reworked and are unmaintainable.

From now on I will develop all new systems in the Experimental Branch which  I don't worry about breaking an already stable version of the game. When the game in XP Branch is ready, it will be the next stable version in the DefaultBranch.(V0.3.0 is next stable version)

After V0.3.0 I will develop the game in this fasion and alway have a stable version while I breaking things in XP Branch without worry.

See you next time with actual update.:emofdr:

notes.title: Devblog #2 with update V0.2.0
notes.notes:
[h1][b]First of all, Special Thank[/b][/h1]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31592810/c851f521f5f28b690f52d51302ec218fcd1396f3.png[/img]
[b]ZAP Hosting[/b] sponsor us(you and me) 2 VPS servers so we can have the game server open 24/7 from now and I can develop multiplayer features more frequently. You can visit their website [url=www.ZAP-Hosting.com][/url] to find more services.

[h1][b]What are in V0.2.0[/b][/h1]
This version is in multiplayer  mode(dedicated server). It take place in IndustrialZone. In the previous version you have worked very hard to earn money and to buy items. Some of you have a business mind and invest in currency items which make them do less work and more rich. So this version [b]HAILIndustries[/b] want to make a business with you. They built 20 small factories for renting.

Please note that the market only work when you see green text "Export Allowed" like this. Otherwise exporting will fail and someone has to poke me in Discord.
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31592810/e0f773b82e9e6a9d1225e792bff4bd8af147a426.jpg[/img]

First you'll need to redeem money to your account(LittleArctic Government Bank) from [b]Trading Center[/b] building.
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31592810/779a99da0391a1a17ff3e8d0931ebd930de7b2e1.jpg[/img]

At the reception desk you can redeem money from these Steam Items.
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31592810/febf5b9cb0a271b108a1723d637abfff17a008f9.png[/img]
[i]Labour Bond[/i]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31592810/4d43007b25d1b21ec3d721ad081c445ed0248b79.png[/img]
[i]Business Bond[/i]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31592810/7725c6249adc3f8d897248f7a2f9d57b2959568c.png[/img]
[i]Business Trip[/i]

Press F to open menu, and drag item to the right. You can either redeem to account or buy-back to items. [b][u]In case of redeeming it will consume your Steam Item.[/u][/b] You may have to click refresh button too.
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31592810/068b41dc6d44e25591ff45484bea086c34f241f1.jpg[/img]

After that you will need to import items from CargoService (at the blue mini-container office nearby). [b][u]Importing will consume you Steam Items.[/u][/b] 
Importable items for now are
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31592810/d32716d79efb5b7d97f14d13f986ab5843434951.png[/img]
[i]People's Car[/i] need for People's Roadster
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31592810/129374c7d39b6849d8fede84da135b1c14b26268.png[/img]
[i]Heavy Oil (Barrel)[/i] 200 Litres
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31592810/8cc4bb1b7affcd8587d3506d802ef9204fe3a84e.png[/img]
[i]Heavy Oil (Tank)[/i] 20,000 Litres

You can import specific amount of item.
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31592810/376021864221055694cceba4c2f10cc6146021ce.jpg[/img]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31592810/7131520fbff10b067570ce69b80c37321d88b8b7.jpg[/img]

You may need to click refresh button to see if your cargo is update.

Now you can go to any small factory to order new items. If your order success [b][u]you'll see that money and oil decrease from your account.[/u][/b]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31592810/3d60bb9161cce09267ef71b47f88fc7a6c7a981f.jpg[/img]

Every factory have limited capacity so each of them will accept order only one per person. This mean you can have maximum 20 orders(from 20 factories) at a time in one server.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31592810/358ca1bc1306ca9da7e578339469613c6f964399.jpg[/img]

Every order need 15 minutes to complete. When the order completed they will send new items to your inventory automatically and you even don't have be in the game. [b]For example, if your order is the 20th in a queue you have to wait (15x20=300 Minutes) 5 hours.[/b]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31592810/98f80ae500b003f597433dbbf62efee6a6f44d16.png[/img]

[b][u]Important : If the market status is "Export not Allowed" all order that finished after that time will failed to delivery and no refund for this case.[/u] So someone need to contact me from discord as soon as possible. Maybe I can fix something quick enough.[/b] However it's unlikely to happen.

In the first month I will open 2 servers, after that I will use Experimental Server to test new gameplay.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31592810/da50eee024871d9463ee35a7ea3561afcb155a58.jpg[/img]

All gameplay for this version end here. I hope you get items you may need for use in the future.

[h1]What I will do next?[/h1]
- [b][u]remove itempacker branch[/u][/b] , the reason is I need you to sell item only quantity of 1 per listing like typical games(as many listing you need). Because matching system has limitation which allow any buyer to buy from any listing only once. So when someone sell item in stack and sell the cheapest, buyer will can only buy for the first time, the second time will not success(the market will get clogged in this case). So new set of item will unlikely to cause this problem.(1 item per listing).
- Swap V0.1.4 to [b]testdrivemap[/b] branch. So you can play that map and get items until it expired. On 1st September that map will stop dropping item forever. So if you need some items you will need to get them before that day.
- Rework on Vehicle Physics. If it goes well we'll have Land,Air and Sea Vehicle in one research.
- Rework on Character movement for reduce jittering.
- Create my own netcode, for better networked gameplay.

I'll trying to make new small experimental rather than big update like this and make it modular for easy testing. You can join my Discord for Bug Reporting [url=https://discord.gg/ddbTzSu][/url]


[h1]You can send me financial support (or tell someone to do)[/h1]
to one of these links.
[url=https://www.paypal.me/simonjames247][/url]
[url=https://www.patreon.com/simonjames247][/url]


See you next time. :emofdr:

notes.title: Devblog #1 with update V0.1.0
notes.notes:
[h1]Important Note[/h1]
[b]After this version there will be no minor update or bugfix until Version 0.2.0[/b]
I will only add more items to "The International Market" as v0.1.1.
I need about 4 months to rework all major system include Co-op Mode, Dedicated Server Mode, Voice Chat and more.
[b]Next announcement expected to be on 13th July 2018.[/b]

But I will post Devblog when the game has progression.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31592810/2e115b2aa887c23db14476beb7b9955d37df464b.jpg[/img]

[h1]Before go to actual update[/h1]

I must explain some basic rules that will comprise to the complex economy in Villages.

1.Steam Item can be obtained in [b]Dedicated-Server Mode only.[/b] 
But before V0.2.0 I allow purchasing in SinglePlayer/Coop mode for limited time.

Ability to redeem Steam item for in game item and to exchange between Steam item(unboxing, claim Lottery) still allowed in the final version of game in every modes.

2. You can exchange in-game item to Steam item with 2:1 ratio, plus transportation fee and tax. (From CargoService to The International Market).
So now is the best time for stock goods due to temporary 1:1 exchange ratio.


[h1]Now an actual update[/h1]

- You still have one job that is "Test Driving" but this time the car has manual transmission. You have to drive along the road to the end.  If you really reach the end point you will get 1 Payload and need to deliver it at where you start and you will recieve 30000 Kattas.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31592810/cebb0339d1aef5aff0b72437521d5c5efb4630dd.jpg[/img]

- You can spend your hard-earned money at Trading Post by using the computer that has direct access to The International Market.

The limitations are you can only purchase one item for each type per processing(every 90 seconds). After puchases order is in queue you can leave the Trade Post, when order completed there will be notifications messages send to you. [b]No save implemented yet[/b] so make sure you spend all money before leave the game.

- About every 10 minutes when you [b]vistit Trading Post[/b] you will recieve Bonds interest from "LittileArctic Government".(calculated from every bonds you hold in your Steam Inventory) There are 4 Bonds available, all of them give 5% of their value for example "Business Bond has 1 million Kattas in value will give 50,000 Kattas interest".
[b]In final version the interest will automatically paid per real-time hours by Dedicated-Server you playing in and time is accumulate only when you are actually playing in that server.[/b]

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31592810/6c586795c94da0c880b272b6b9944f55c71ebea2.jpg[/img]

- If your car really stuck you can reset it by walk in front of a phone booth.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31592810/433bdf95aabde375755b431f33963104f852ed9f.jpg[/img]

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31592810/98c66e6b235f578ad3671c74d29476ee8e7c6eb5.jpg[/img]

-If yourself stuck in terrain,[b] try press R when you align your face out of object you stuck in.[/b]

- If you cannot unstuck [b] press Home to teleport to the base.[/b]

[h1]P.S.[/h1]

 I will add a few more items to The International Market within a week as v0.1.1 but without announcement.(See version in upper-left corner in the game)

See you next time. ːemofdrː
